name: Bigcapital
description: Open source accounting and bookkeeping platform for small and medium businesses.
composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
{{ports}}
    environment:
      TZ: {{env.TZ}}
      DB_HOST: "{{serviceName}}-mysql"
      DB_NAME: bigcapital
      DB_USER: bigcapital
      DB_PASSWORD: {{env.MYSQL_PASSWORD}}
      REDIS_HOST: "{{serviceName}}-redis"
      MYSQL_PASSWORD: {{env.MYSQL_PASSWORD}}
      JWT_SECRET: {{env.JWT_SECRET}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/data:/var/www/bigcapital/storage
    depends_on:
      - {{serviceName}}-mysql
      - {{serviceName}}-redis
  {{serviceName}}-mysql:
    image: mysql:8
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-mysql
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      MYSQL_DATABASE: bigcapital
      MYSQL_USER: bigcapital
      MYSQL_PASSWORD: {{env.MYSQL_PASSWORD}}
      MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD: {{env.MYSQL_PASSWORD}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/mysql:/var/lib/mysql
  {{serviceName}}-redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-redis
    restart: unless-stopped
